# GitOps repository: uat, prod

Generated by [gitopsify](https://github.com/hayone1/gitopsify) test from offline (clickops.yaml).
Regenerate with `gitopsify generate -c gitopsify.yaml`; files you add by hand are kept.

Read [MIGRATION_REPORT.md](MIGRATION_REPORT.md) before the first sync: it lists what was left out and why, and what needs your attention.

## Layout

```
apps/<app>/base/              manifests (or Helm values) exported from the source cluster
apps/<app>/envs/<env>/        per-environment overlay: patches and values overrides
apps/<app>/charts/<chart>/    charts rebuilt from Helm releases whose repository is unknown
apply-<env>.sh                applies every app in order with server-side apply
```

## Bootstrap

These are plain manifests: wire them into the tool of your choice. Every `apps/<app>/envs/<env>` directory is a Kustomization (`kustomize build`, with `--enable-helm` for Helm apps).

To apply an environment by hand, in order:

```sh
./apply-uat.sh --context <target-context>
```

## Before the first sync

1. Read MIGRATION_REPORT.md, especially *Secrets that need action* and *Warnings*.
2. Check the target cluster: `gitopsify check -c gitopsify.yaml --env <env>` verifies API versions, StorageClasses and IngressClasses.
3. Preview the first sync: `gitopsify diff -c gitopsify.yaml --env <env>` server-side dry-runs every object against the target.
